body:
## Problem

`get_active_parents_referencing_label` is the one reference listing without a result cap. Its names are joined into label-move and label-delete error messages, so a partial referenced by thousands of prompts produces an enormous error body.

## Changes

- The listing takes the same 100-entry cap as its two sibling helpers, ordered by name in SQL. Existence-based guards stay correct: over the cap still means "referenced".

## How did you test this code?

- No new test: the guards' behavior is unchanged and already covered; the cap mirrors the tested siblings.

## Automatic notifications

- [ ] Publish to changelog?

## Docs update

None.
